profile.headline: Software Engineer at Adobe
profile.geoLocationName: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States
profile.summary:
I am a Software Engineer with over fifteen years of experience and leadership in many aspects of software development, system design, and distributed systems. I particularly enjoy rallying a team around a shared vision and teaching other engineers how to apply themselves and their skills to produce higher-quality products that we can be proud of. I have led large teams and small teams, made engaging presentations to directors of customer organizations for contracts worth tens of millions of dollars, and educated numerous engineers about how to effectively improve their craft.

Specialties: C++, Golang, Python, Typescript, Docker, AWS, Kafka, Domain-Driven Design, Event Sourcing, Angular, Java, Relational Databases, Web Development

positions.title: Software Engineer/Part Owner
positions.description: Contract and in-house development work, including: collectible card game management website, implemented in Angular with NestJS backend, using Azure DevOps for project management and CI/CD; prototype development for Google Slides plugin for study helps using React frontend and NestJS backend.

positions.title: Team Lead and Manager
positions.description:
Providing day-to-day leadership, including task management, 1:1 meetings, and performance reviews for team of 6 engineers that owns company’s microscope image data. Mentoring team in writing clean, reliable code, introduced initiatives to streamline complexity and reliability. Designed and implementing migration from monolithic Golang application backed by MySQL to collection of microservices in Typescript, Golang, and Python backed by AWS Dynamo, GraphQL, and AWS SNS/SQS.

Contributing to the architecture and design of additional microservices throughout the company's tech stack.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Created and integrated NestJS service for generating visually distinctive custom PDF reports for customer home inspection mold findings, improved performance and maintainability for deep learning AI pipeline, and refined AI training pipeline management tools.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Officially took Technical Lead position for system control team; responsible for direct technical guidance, architectural decisions, codebase health and maintenance, and task management for team of 36 engineers.

Overseeing development and deployment of event-driven microservices-based architecture using Docker and Apache Kafka.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Continued managing tasks for team of 20 engineers for team's largest contract. In addition, became direct technical lead for a team of 4 engineers, performing DevOps support for our own specialized section of the system monitoring software as well as providing front-line support for the larger software project.

Began work with several other engineers on designing and developing a new microservice-based architecture using Docker, Apache Kafka, Influx, and Grafana.

Took on Lead Architect position on the system control team and began assuming direct technical lead responsibilities for team of 25 engineers in September 2017.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Began working on specialized area of larger system-control application, involved in signal control and analysis. Participated in routine DevOps work. Also took on responsibilities for task management for team of 15 engineers for my team's largest contract.

Designed and developed communication protocol for new intersystem messaging system which now forms an integral part of the company's overall system solution.

positions.title: Developer/Owner
positions.description: Developing tools and programs for making life's small tasks easier.  Also developing programs upon request for commercial organizations.
